sourceText:
Garlic Lime Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:22pm

Ingredients




Deliciously marinated with "Southwest-style" seasonings, these
chicken breasts go well with steamed zuc
Makes 6 servings
1/4 cup lime juice
 cup olive oil
2 tablespoons tequila (optional)
1 teaspoon McCormick(r) Cilantro Leaves
1 teaspoon McCormick(r) Garlic Powder
1/4 teaspoon McCormick(r) Ground Cumin
1/4 teaspoon McCormick(r) Ground Red Pepper
1/4 teaspoon salt
1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts

Preparation

1 1. Combine all ingredients except chicken in a glass dish or large self-closing plastic bag. Add chicken, turn to coat. Cover or close bag. 2 Refrigerate 15 minutes. 3 2. Remove chicken from marinade and grill or broil 5-7 minutes per side. 4 Baste with marinade halfway through cooking, if desired.
